# Tank Tracks Medium Research

Section: Research Path > Makes available

## Tank Tracks Medium

[![Tanktracksmediumresearch](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/51/Tanktracksmediumresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421190607)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/5/51/Tanktracksmediumresearch.png/revision/latest?cb=20240421190607)

### Research Points

32

### Research Time

0h 30m

## Research Path

### Unlocked by

[Land Vehicles](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Land_Vehicles_Research), [Heavy Land Vehicles](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Heavy_Land_Vehicles_Research), [Tank Tracks Small](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Tank_Tracks_Small_Research)

### Makes available

[Tank Tracks Large](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Tank_Tracks_Large_Research)

Tank tracks medium is a [researchable](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research) item which unlocks the following components:

| Category | Component |
| --- | --- |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Wheel (Large) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Drive Wheel (Large) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Wheel (Medium) |
| [Vehicle Control](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Wiki/Building/Components/Vehicle_Control) | Tank Drive Wheel (Medium) |
